fullDescription: A full-bleed neo-brutalist 'acid' sticky navbar: an electric acid-yellow band with a hard 3px ink-black border holding a boxed-monogram PROMPTS/LAB wordmark, wipe-in underline center links, and a cluster of square paper-white hard-shadowed buttons (a ⌘K search field, an 8.4k star count, an X-social icon) ending in a black-on-acid START FREE CTA, with a black Space-Mono ticker marquee scrolling beneath. Archivo Black + Space Mono, Lucide icons, chunky offset box-shadows, every control presses on hover/active, and it collapses to a burger + stacked acid drawer on mobile.

structured.summary: A full-bleed neo-brutalist 'acid' sticky navbar: an electric acid-yellow (#e8ff00) band with a hard 3px ink-black bottom border, pinning a boxed-monogram wordmark (a black 'P' tile + 'PROMPTS/LAB'), a row of underline-on-hover center links (Library, Components, Canvas, Pricing, Docs), and a right cluster of hard-shadowed paper-white control buttons (a 'Search prompts' field with a ⌘K key, an 8.4k star count, an X-social icon) ending in a black-on-acid 'START FREE' CTA. A black ink ticker marquee scrolls beneath the bar. Built on Archivo / Archivo Black / Space Mono with Lucide icons and chunky 'hard' offset box-shadows, every control presses 2px on hover and 5px on active. It reflows to a search + black burger pair that toggles a stacked acid drawer on mobile.

style.description: An aggressive neo-brutalist / 'acid' aesthetic: a single electric acid-yellow (#e8ff00) carries the whole brand, set against near-black ink (#0a0a0a) and a warm off-white paper (#f4f4ec). Everything is squared-off (no rounded corners), framed in heavy 3px (or 2px) ink borders, and lifted on hard, un-blurred offset box-shadows (solid black at 3/5/7px offset) so controls look like physical stickers you can press. Typography does the shouting: ultra-heavy Archivo Black for the wordmark and uppercase headings with tight negative tracking, bold Archivo for nav labels, and Space Mono for monospaced metadata (counts, the ticker, the ⌘K key). Hover presses a control 2px into its shadow, active slams it 5px flat. No gradients, no soft shadows, maximum contrast.
style.prompt: Use an aggressive neo-brutalist 'acid' design system built on the Tailwind CDN with these exact custom tokens: colors acid #e8ff00 (the one electric accent, the nav band + highlights + the CTA's text-on-black), ink #0a0a0a (all borders, text, hard shadows, and the black CTA/ticker fills), paper #f4f4ec (the warm off-white page + button fills), band #1a1a1a. Fonts (Google Fonts): grotesk = Archivo (weights 400/600/700/800/900) for body + bold nav labels, black = 'Archivo Black' for the wordmark and uppercase headings, mono = 'Space Mono' (400/700) for counts, the ⌘K key, and the ticker. Define custom hard offset box-shadows (un-blurred, solid): hardsm = '3px 3px 0 0 #0a0a0a', hard = '5px 5px 0 0 #0a0a0a', hardlg = '7px 7px 0 0 #0a0a0a', plus hard-acid = '5px 5px 0 0 #e8ff00'. Borders are square and heavy: a `.ink-border` = 3px solid #0a0a0a and `.ink-border-2` = 2px solid #0a0a0a; no border-radius anywhere. Add a `.tracker` utility = letter-spacing -0.03em on the wordmark/headings. Make every control feel physical with a `.press` transition (transform .08s, box-shadow .08s): on hover translate(2px,2px) (and shrink a `.has-hard` shadow to 3px), on active translate(5px,5px) and flatten the shadow to 0. Body is `bg-paper text-ink antialiased` with a custom selection (`selection:bg-ink selection:text-acid`). Icons are Iconify Lucide (lucide:search, lucide:star, lucide:arrow-up-right, lucide:menu, lucide:arrow-right, lucide:play, lucide:check) plus ri:twitter-x-fill for the social button. No gradients, no blur, maximum black-on-acid contrast.

layout_and_structure.description: A `sticky top-0 z-50` `<header>` of two stacked full-bleed tiers: (1) a `w-full bg-acid` nav band with a 3px ink bottom border whose inner content centers in a `mx-auto max-w-[1240px] px-5 lg:px-8` column at a 76px (lg 84px) row height, laying out three zones - a boxed-monogram wordmark on the left, an `mx-auto` row of five center links (desktop only), and a right cluster of hard-shadowed paper buttons ending in the black 'START FREE' CTA; (2) a black `bg-ink text-acid` ticker strip with an infinite monospace marquee. A mobile cluster (search icon + black burger) replaces the links + right cluster below lg and toggles a stacked acid drawer (`#drawer`, hidden by default, links + CTA as full-width hard-shadowed bars) rendered between the bar and the ticker.

prompts.partPt: Sticky two-tier Menu do Topo shell
prompts.prompt: Wrap everything in a `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50">` containing, in order: a `<nav class="w-full bg-acid border-b-[3px] border-ink">` (the acid band, which also contains the hidden mobile drawer) and then a full-width black ticker strip (`w-full bg-ink text-acid border-b-[3px] border-ink overflow-hidden`). The header pins flush to the top of the viewport and the page scrolls beneath it.

Inside the `bg-acid` nav, center the content in a `mx-auto max-w-[1240px] px-5 lg:px-8` container holding a single `flex items-center justify-between gap-6 h-[76px] lg:h-[84px]` row. The row has three parts left to right: the wordmark (shrink-0), the desktop center links (hidden below lg, `mx-auto` so they sit centered), and the desktop right cluster (shrink-0, hidden below lg) - plus a separate mobile cluster (shown below lg).

An anchor `flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0 group`: a `grid place-items-center h-11 w-11 lg:h-12 lg:w-12 bg-ink text-acid ink-border shadow-hardsm press has-hard` square tile holding an Archivo-Black 'P' (`font-black text-2xl lg:text-[26px] leading-none`), beside an Archivo-Black `.tracker text-[20px] lg:text-[24px] leading-none whitespace-nowrap` wordmark reading 'PROMPTS' + a faded ink/40 '/' + 'LAB'.

A `hidden lg:flex items-center gap-7 xl:gap-8 font-grotesk font-bold text-[15px] .tracker mx-auto` list of five links: Library, Components, Canvas, Pricing, Docs. Each is a `.navlink` whose `::after` is a 3px ink underline pinned `bottom: -6px`, width 0 at rest, animating to width 100% on hover over .18s ease (a wipe-in underline).

A `hidden lg:flex items-center gap-2.5 shrink-0` group of hard-shadowed paper-white controls, each `bg-paper ink-border shadow-hardsm press has-hard`: (1) a full 'Search prompts' button shown only at 2xl (`hidden 2xl:flex items-center gap-3 pl-3.5 pr-3 h-11`) with a lucide:search icon, a `font-grotesk font-semibold text-[14px] text-ink/60` label, and a Space-Mono `⌘K` kbd on an acid `ink-border-2` chip; a search-icon-only fallback (`grid 2xl:hidden place-items-center h-11 w-11`) below 2xl; (2) a star-count link (`flex items-center gap-2 px-3 h-11`) with a lucide:star icon + a Space-Mono bold '8.4k'; (3) an icon button (`grid place-items-center h-11 w-11`) with ri:twitter-x-fill. Then the primary CTA: `flex items-center gap-2 bg-ink text-acid ink-border px-5 h-11 shadow-hard press has-hard font-black .tracker text-[15px] uppercase` reading 'START FREE' + a lucide:arrow-up-right icon (the only black-filled, acid-text control, on the bigger 5px hard shadow).

A `flex lg:hidden items-center gap-2.5` cluster replaces the links + right cluster below lg: a paper search-icon button (`bg-paper ink-border h-11 w-11 shadow-hardsm press has-hard`, lucide:search) and a black burger button (`id="burger" grid place-items-center bg-ink text-acid ink-border h-11 w-11 shadow-hardsm press has-hard`, lucide:menu). The drawer is `<div id="drawer" class="hidden lg:hidden border-t-[3px] border-ink bg-acid">` inside the nav, after the row: a `mx-auto max-w-[1240px] px-5 py-5 flex flex-col gap-3` stack of five full-width `font-black .tracker text-xl ink-border bg-paper px-4 py-3 shadow-hardsm` link bars (Library/Components/Canvas/Pricing/Docs) plus a black `bg-ink text-acid ... shadow-hard` 'START FREE' bar with an arrow-up-right icon. A tiny script toggles the drawer's `hidden` class on burger click.

Below the acid band, a `w-full bg-ink text-acid border-b-[3px] border-ink overflow-hidden` strip with a `flex whitespace-nowrap` row animated by a `.marquee` keyframe (`animation: scroll 26s linear infinite`, translateX 0 to -50%). Duplicate the content twice (the second copy `aria-hidden`) for a seamless loop. Each copy is a `flex shrink-0` of Space-Mono `font-bold text-[13px] uppercase .tracker py-2` items separated by '/' slashes: '★ 12,000+ prompts', 'Infinite canvas', 'Idea → shippable UI', 'Drives Claude Code & Cursor'.

Below lg, hide the center links and the desktop right cluster and show the mobile cluster (search icon + burger); the burger toggles the stacked acid drawer (links + CTA as full-width hard-shadowed bars). Between lg and 2xl the right cluster shows a search-icon-only button; only at 2xl does the full 'Search prompts + ⌘K' field appear. The wordmark tile and text bump up one size at lg (h-12 / text-[24px]) and the bar grows from 76px to 84px tall.

special_ui_components.prompt: Give every control a physical, sticker-like feel: a square `.ink-border` (3px solid ink), no border-radius, and a hard un-blurred offset shadow (`shadow-hardsm` 3px or `shadow-hard` 5px, solid #0a0a0a). Add a `.press` transition (transform + box-shadow .08s ease) so on hover the control translates(2px,2px) and its `.has-hard` shadow shrinks to 3px, and on active it slams to translate(5px,5px) with the shadow flattened to 0 - it looks pressed flush into the page.

The full search control is a paper-white hard-shadowed button (`bg-paper ink-border pl-3.5 pr-3 h-11`) shown only at 2xl: a lucide:search icon, a `font-grotesk font-semibold text-[14px] text-ink/60` 'Search prompts' label, and a Space-Mono `text-[12px] font-bold` `⌘K` `<kbd>` on an acid `ink-border-2 px-1.5 py-0.5` chip. Below 2xl it collapses to a search-icon-only square button so the bar never overflows.

Each desktop center link is a `.navlink` with `position: relative` and a `::after` bar: `left:0; bottom:-6px; height:3px; width:0; background:#0a0a0a; transition: width .18s ease`, growing to `width:100%` on hover - a thick ink underline that wipes in from the left.

A black full-bleed strip under the nav running a seamless Space-Mono uppercase marquee: duplicate the item run twice in a `flex whitespace-nowrap` row and animate it with `@keyframes scroll { from { transform: translateX(0) } to { transform: translateX(-50%) } }` on a `.marquee` class at `26s linear infinite`. Items ('★ 12,000+ prompts', 'Infinite canvas', 'Idea → shippable UI', 'Drives Claude Code & Cursor') are separated by '/' slashes; mark the second copy `aria-hidden`.

Pair a square black monogram tile (`bg-ink text-acid ink-border shadow-hardsm`, an Archivo-Black 'P') with an Archivo-Black `.tracker` wordmark 'PROMPTS/LAB' where the '/' is dimmed to ink/40 - the tile itself is a `.press has-hard` control so the logo reacts on hover like the buttons.

structured.special_notes: Exact color tokens (Tailwind config): acid #e8ff00 (the single electric accent: the nav band, the highlight chip, the CTA's text-on-black, selection text, deco blocks), ink #0a0a0a (every border, all text, the hard shadows, and the black CTA + ticker + monogram fills), paper #f4f4ec (warm off-white page + button fills), band #1a1a1a (defined, used sparingly). Fonts (Google Fonts): grotesk = Archivo (400/600/700/800/900), black = 'Archivo Black', mono = 'Space Mono' (400/700) - the wordmark + uppercase headings use font-black with a custom .tracker letter-spacing -0.03em; counts, the ⌘K key, and the ticker are Space Mono. Custom hard (un-blurred, solid-black) box-shadows: hardsm '3px 3px 0 0 #0a0a0a', hard '5px 5px 0 0 #0a0a0a', hardlg '7px 7px 0 0 #0a0a0a', hard-acid '5px 5px 0 0 #e8ff00'. Borders are square + heavy: .ink-border 3px solid #0a0a0a, .ink-border-2 2px solid #0a0a0a, no border-radius anywhere. The .press interaction (transform/box-shadow .08s) presses every .has-hard control 2px on hover (shadow to 3px) and 5px on active (shadow to 0). Icons: Iconify Lucide (search, star, arrow-up-right, menu, arrow-right, play, check) + ri:twitter-x-fill. The header is `sticky top-0 z-50` with two full-bleed tiers (acid band + black marquee) sharing the centered `max-w-[1240px] px-5 lg:px-8` column; bar height 76px -> 84px at lg. Built with the Tailwind CDN + Iconify. The page beneath (a grid-paper brutalist hero with an uppercase 'DESIGN AT THE [SPEED] OF PROMPT' H1, deco blocks, two CTA buttons, mono trust line, and an acid 'Trusted across the stack' proof band) is demo context so the sticky bar has something to scroll over; the prompt-library value is the navbar pattern itself.
